integrity: Analytical proof independent of finite tests. Exact-rational checker reconstructed all pairwise distances for a bounded grid. Originality is a best-knowledge literature comparison, not a claim of exhaustive priority search.
scientific_limitations: Only vertex metrics of unit-edge regular rooted trees of depth two with two or more children and two or more leaves per child; unrestricted real Hilbert targets; no claims about nonregular, weighted, fixed-dimensional, or greater-depth trees.
title: Sharp Hilbert distortion and optimizer rigidity for depth-two regular trees
